svg.title: Pastry Pirates — V3 · The Round Table — Extras
svg.desc: A rules card with the numbers the app keeps for you. (The storm cloud and first-player wheel were cut on 2026-08-25 — the needle parked in a storm wedge is the forecast.) Units: mm. 25 mm squares, 5.9 mm material. KERF-COMPENSATED: cut lines offset 0.1375 mm away from the kept wood (kerf 0.275 mm) — cut exactly on the line. RASTER = black fill (engrave), CUT = red hairline (cut). Generated by physical-board/generate.mjs.
